rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: Replying to the debate on 11 April 1997, Shri H.D. Deve Gowda says: 'As long as Shri Narasimha Rao was the President, there was no problem. On the day when Shri Sitaram Kesari became the President of the Congress Party, I called him for lunch.'
